Jisrmed AI is a clinical intelligence company built around structured patient conversations that empower better clinical and operational decisions for physicians and institutions across MENA healthcare.

Jisrmed is the first point of interaction between a patient and their care.

Before the waiting room, before the file, before the consultation begins, Jisrmed is where the visit truly starts.

The problem

The most important part of the visit is the most rushed.

In high-volume clinics, the consultation is compressed into minutes. The history that drives the diagnosis, and the documentation that records it, both suffer for it.

Incomplete history. Incomplete diagnosis.

No time to ask everything

With only minutes per patient, history-taking is squeezed. The key detail is often the question there was never time to ask, buried in family history, medications, or a systems review that gets skipped under pressure.

History carries the diagnosis

Around 80% of diagnoses rest primarily on the patient's history. When the most decisive part of the encounter is also the most rushed, findings are missed, and a missed finding is a missed diagnosis.

Every minute typing is a minute taken from the patient.

Documentation consumes the visit

Physicians re-enter the same data by hand, visit after visit. On heavy days some clinics hire a second person purely for data entry: cost added, attention still divided.

The doctor talks to a screen

When the keyboard competes with the patient for the physician's attention, the consultation suffers. Documentation burden is a leading driver of physician burnout.

Backed-up waiting rooms

In heavy clinics, waiting times stretch into hours, and the experience frays before the visit even starts.

No-shows waste revenue

Every patient who books and doesn't arrive is a lost slot and lost revenue that can't be recovered.

Findings never recorded

What isn't asked isn't documented, and what isn't documented can't inform the next decision.

Stop typing data. Start practicing medicine.
How it works

The intelligence arrives before the patient does.

Jisrmed runs a structured, guideline-grounded interview with the patient before the consultation, then hands the physician an organized clinical picture, ready to read.

Patient
Engine
Physician

The patient is interviewed

Before the visit, at home or in the waiting room, the patient completes a structured interview in Arabic or English. No time pressure. The full protocol runs, every time.

The engine structures it

A rule-based clinical engine, grounded in international guidelines, organizes the answers, follows up on red flags, and adapts to how the patient responds. Not a free-running chatbot.

The physician reads the report

An organized history, flagged findings, and a full case presentation are waiting on arrival, so the visit starts with interpretation, not collection.

Built on a hybrid architecture. A deterministic, guideline-grounded engine forms the clinical backbone; AI handles natural-language understanding, adaptation, and empathy. The structure is what keeps it safe. The intelligence never runs unbounded.

Deployment

One intelligence, tailored to how you already work.

The same clinical intelligence meets your infrastructure where it is, from a clinic running on paper to one with an established EMR.

Lightweight dashboard

For clinics with no existing system. A clean, read-only view where the structured report waits for the physician. Nothing to install, nothing to migrate.

EMR integration

For clinics with a system already in place. Structured history flows into the right fields through RPA or API, designed to minimize workflow disruption and duplicate entry.

Embedded clinic system

For centers that need both intelligence and the system around it. The full clinic layer with the pre-visit intelligence built in from the start.

Jisrmed is a clinical intelligence layer, not a filing cabinet. The intelligence is the product. The deployment mode is simply how it reaches your clinic.

What changes

A better visit, for the physician and the patient.

When the history is done before the visit begins, the whole encounter shifts.

Documentation, done before the visit

The history is captured and entered before the consultation begins. No second data-entry hire, no typing from scratch.

The full picture, on arrival

A complete, protocol-driven history is ready to read, capturing what a rushed few minutes would miss.

Every patient is fully heard

The interview gives each patient the space to tell their whole story, and a physician who arrives already listening. That is better care.

Time back, spent your way

Minutes saved are the physician's to use: see more patients, or give each one more attention. The choice stays with the doctor.

Less time collecting. More time deciding.
Jisr
جِسر

A bridge between the patient and the physician.

Jisr is the Arabic word for bridge. We chose it deliberately. A bridge closes the distance between two points.

Jisrmed closes the distance between an unprepared consultation and an informed one. Between what the patient knows and what the physician needs to know. Between the moment care begins and the moment the visit starts.

Our vision

We are building the Arabic clinical intelligence infrastructure for MENA healthcare.

The layer that connects every patient conversation to every clinical and operational decision. Arabic-native, built from the ground up, and starting at the first point of interaction between a patient and their care.

Designed by a physician who has lived the problem from both sides.

Jisrmed is built by a medical doctor who has sat on both sides of the consultation: rushing through a history with no time to spare, and watching a patient leave without having been fully heard.

That is why the clinical reasoning comes first and the software follows. Jisrmed supports the physician; it never replaces them. Every clinical decision remains entirely with the doctor.
